title: Proposed federal Section 106 historic review changes
summary: On September 3, commissioners discussed a federal proposal to rewrite Section 106 rules protecting historic properties, and approved a letter with no opposition. Staff said the change would leave consultation with Native Hawaiian organizations up to federal agencies. That echoes an August 6 staff warning that agencies could decide whether to consult at all.

Staff said the change would leave consultation with Native Hawaiian organizations up to federal agencies.
